authorization_basis: standing user authorization plus B61 real pre-cutoff context release
single_changed_variable: literal chronological representation versus uncertainty-bearing pragmatic-state representation
success_condition: both conditions complete exactly two calls, emit exact six-label normalized probabilities plus Japanese next-content predictions, persist only hashes and accounting for intermediate representations/prompts/responses, and freeze an immutable result before any future outcome access
failure_condition: any input hash, provider, schema, language, probability, call-count, persistence, retry, or future-access violation produces a terminal redacted failure and does not authorize outcome unlock
claim_boundary: B62 is one exploratory real temporal row. A completed prediction still cannot establish correctness until the future is separately unlocked and cannot establish general system advantage even after one-row scoring.
